Book a call

Clear advice for the decisions that matter most.

Halden & Rowe is a management consulting firm for owner-led and mid-sized companies. We help leaders fix what's slowing them down, plan their next stage of growth and see the plan through.

Book a free 30-minute callSee client results
$310Min extra profit found for our clients since 2012, measured by their own finance teams.
Where we help

You've grown. Now the old way of running things is getting in the way.

Most of our clients call us at the same point: revenue is up, but profit, speed or morale is going the wrong way. These are the problems we solve most often.

  1. 01

    Profit isn't keeping up with sales

    We find where margin is leaking in pricing, suppliers and operations, and fix it within one quarter.

  2. 02

    Every decision still goes through the owner

    We design a leadership team, roles and reporting so the business can run without you in every meeting.

  3. 03

    Growth plans stay on paper

    We turn strategy into a 12-month plan with owners, budgets and monthly check-ins that actually happen.

  4. 04

    A sale, merger or succession is coming

    We prepare the business, the numbers and the people so you get the best price and a smooth handover.

Services

Three ways we work with leaders.

Strategy

Where to compete, what to stop doing and how to fund the plan. Built with your team, not handed to them.

  • Growth and market strategy
  • Pricing reviews
  • Board and investor planning

Operations

Faster processes, lower costs and fewer mistakes, from the warehouse floor to the finance office.

  • Cost and margin reviews
  • Process redesign
  • Supplier negotiations

People & leadership

The structure, roles and habits that let a company grow without burning out its best people.

  • Leadership team coaching
  • Organisation design
  • Succession planning

FAQ

Before you call us.

How much does a consulting project cost?

Most projects cost between $40,000 and $180,000, depending on size and length. After our first call we send a fixed fee in writing, so there are no surprises.

How long does a typical project take?

Between 8 and 20 weeks. Many clients then keep us on a small monthly retainer for a year to keep the plan on track.

Do you work with small businesses?

We work best with companies that have between 30 and 2,000 staff. For smaller firms we run a six-week growth programme at a lower fixed price.

Will you work alongside my team?

Yes. We build the plan with your managers so they own it. We don't write a report and disappear.

Contact

Tell us what's keeping you up at night.

Book a free 30-minute call with a partner. You'll get an honest view of the problem and what it would take to fix, even if we're not the right fit.

Source: https://github.com/mmrahmanbappi/100-free-html-templates/blob/bab6ec6c8900450aab90989d217942a67ad9b16d/business/consulting-firm/index.html

Extract the ZIP and open index.html. No build, npm dependencies or remote CDN is required.

The upstream/ folder preserves original source with its MIT notice. Root index.html is the separately documented MigBits adaptation.

Replace fictional sample business content, connect your own backend and retain the included license notices. Forms, data and payments are demonstrations.

Use Pause motion or your operating system reduced-motion preference. Full production and accessibility review remains your responsibility.

Original single-file HTML/CSS/inline JavaScript retained separately with creator MIT notice.

Stock photography, external fonts, favicons, metadata and remote services are excluded from the runnable edition; original HTML references are preserved as text only.

No React conversion is claimed. System font fallback changes the upstream typography. Render validation is not a complete accessibility audit.

Mobile grid minimum widths and word wrapping are corrected for community-center and nonprofit-charity. Dynamic photo references and initially empty image viewers use original artwork.

The original download-promotion toolbar is removed from runnable pages; creator attribution and complete copyright notices remain. Photo credit labels reflect the replacement MigBits artwork.
